model_screen.note: Initial finite cell ceiling follows latest retained runs; admit measured preparation separately; repeat cells only under the sealed experiment budget.

review_bounded.note: Reviewer availability is an external capability; timing out never grants review. Human work may be resumed as a separately leased packet.

policy.initial_scope: Pinned US Code source and span/entity caches; other legal corpora and case law require separately admitted source generations.
policy.correctness: All accepted records pass their applicable evidence vector; ambiguous, conflicting, unknown and unsupported material stays explicit. No promise that arbitrary natural-language interpretation is mechanically decidable.
policy.source_semantic_admission: Every accepted semantic record carries independent authenticated source/context/target review, or an independently qualified proof-carrying restricted-grammar checker applied to that exact record. Template matching and model consensus alone cannot admit meaning; checker-derived evidence is never labeled human review.
policy.global_consistency: Checked consistency of a complete declared jurisdiction/time/profile/dependency theory. Competing historical or interpretive theories remain separate; actual source conflict is preserved.
policy.launch_gate: LAC-001 and LAC-006 freeze current authorities; LAC-080 verifies actual supervisor transport; LAC-081/082 bind execution/results/resources. This plan starts no campaign.
policy.independent_review: The producer cannot accept its own result. Authentication and competence scope are part of semantic review; model consensus is not independent legal authority.

finite_budgets.provider_model: Existing explicitly capability-probed configuration; no new model or fallback assumed.

policy.checkpoint_policy: Warm starts and full optimizer resumes are separately named; use exact compatible donor and declared loader. Never overwrite historical checkpoints.
policy.unknown_policy: Timeout, missing context, solver unknown, exhausted budget and reviewer unavailability cannot satisfy a correctness gate.
policy.numerical_input_isolation: TRAIN/development targets only inside numerical children; confirmation references and target-bearing context are held by an independent scorer until candidate/policy freeze. Upstream result identity does not grant blanket payload access.
policy.bootstrap_execution: Finite inventory/code-only work under existing supervisor tests, current resource admission and independent review. No bulk numerical/corpus/Lean dispatch until LAC-080/081/082 pass; setup cannot depend on its own future adapters.
policy.projection_materialization: Native Markdown is structurally validated planning input. LAC-080 must bind checkout-relative ownership and real executable validation commands before live dispatch; custom resource/exclusion/gate metadata is otherwise advisory.
